name: In All This Confusion
description:
*You vanish in a plume of black smoke to avoid danger.*

**Triggered** — Magic — Triggered

**Distance:** Self   **Target:** Self

**Trigger:** You take damage.

**Effect:** You take half the damage, then can teleport up to 4 squares after the triggering effect resolves. Spend 1+ Insight: You teleport 1 additional square for each insight spent.
